en: Added the `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` managed setting to let `claude --chrome` run alongside an exclusive `managed-mcp.json`; the error shown when Chrome is blocked now names it
zh: 新增 `allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp` 托管设置，允许 `claude --chrome` 与独占的 `managed-mcp.json` 同时运行；Chrome 被阻止时显示的错误现在会指明该设置
